purpose: Run an independent perceptual/structural witness after the SHA-256 test. The audio test asks whether related versions are measurably more similar than unrelated same-catalog controls, using decoded audio rather than cryptographic digest shape.

known_before_prereg.sha256_result: 97254 LCS>=5 did not replicate in five new related pairs; a nonconfirmatory fixed-position hint appeared.
known_before_prereg.rule: The SHA result may motivate the audio witness but may not alter the frozen audio metrics after extraction.

source_rule: Use the same Robert Miles official Bandcamp public mp3-128 streams. Decode deterministically with ffmpeg to mono 11025 Hz signed-16 PCM. Do not use track names or SHA values as feature inputs.

disjoint_related_pairs.a: One And One (Robert Miles Radio Version)
disjoint_related_pairs.b: One And One (Radio Without The Beat)

disjointness_rule: No exact track file appears in more than one inferential pair.

frozen_audio_metrics.A1_chroma_profile_cosine: Cosine similarity between whole-track time-averaged 12-bin pitch-class energy profiles computed from STFT magnitude, frequencies 40-5000 Hz.
frozen_audio_metrics.A2_spectral_profile_cosine: Cosine similarity between whole-track normalized 64-bin log-frequency spectral energy profiles, 40-5000 Hz.
frozen_audio_metrics.A3_rms_shape_correlation: Pearson correlation between RMS-envelope trajectories after each whole-track envelope is linearly resampled to exactly 1024 normalized-time points.
frozen_audio_metrics.A4_onset_shape_correlation: Pearson correlation between positive first differences of the normalized RMS envelopes, also at 1024 normalized-time points.
frozen_audio_metrics.A5_tempo_difference_bpm: Absolute difference between approximate dominant tempos estimated from RMS-onset autocorrelation in the 80-180 BPM range.

analysis_plan.group_summary: Arithmetic mean by related/control for all five metrics.
analysis_plan.exact_label_permutation: Enumerate all choose(6,3)=20 allocations of the six frozen pair records into groups of three; one-sided p-values in preregistered directions.
analysis_plan.multiplicity: No single metric is called confirmatory at raw p<0.05. Family-wise sensitivity is reported with Bonferroni over five metrics; with only 20 allocations, the minimum raw one-sided p is 0.05, so this run is primarily effect-size/consistency evidence.
analysis_plan.claim_ceiling: Audio similarity can establish shared musical/production structure, not causal messaging, hidden code, or SHA meaning.

app_bridge_question: Does the Robert Miles version-control experiment instantiate the same general operator independently seen in the Alan Parsons analysis: stable reference + controlled difference -> interpretable change?

ibm_boundary.note: IBM/quantum computation is not needed for this classical audio similarity gate. No claim of SHA reversal or quantum secret extraction is permitted.

canonical_seal: THE SECOND WITNESS LISTENS TO THE AUDIO, NOT THE HASH. IF RELATED VERSIONS ARE CLOSER, THAT IS MUSICAL STRUCTURE; IF THE SHA DIGESTS ARE NOT, THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT A GOOD CRYPTOGRAPHIC HASH SHOULD DO.
